Predicates:
Winner(x, y) ::: x is the winner of y.
Participated(x, y) ::: x participated in y.
TieOnLeaderboard(y, z) ::: y is a tie on the leaderboard z.
FromBelgium(x) ::: x is from Belgium.
OnLeaderboard(x, y) ::: x is on the leaderboard y.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
SameLeaderboard(x, y) ::: x and y are on the same leaderboard.
TopTie(y) ::: y is the top tie on a leaderboard.

Premises:
Winner(Steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: The winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic was Steinhauer.
Participated(Steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∃x (TieOnLeaderboard(x, duMaurier1992) ∧ ∃z (FromBelgium(z) ∧ OnLeaderboard(z, duMaurier1992) ∧ x is a six-way tie)) ::: There was a six-way tie on the leaderboard, and one person in the tie was from Belgium.
Descampe(Descampe) ::: Descampe is from Belgium.
OnLeaderboard(Descampe, duMaurier1992) ::: Descampe is on the leaderboard.
∀x (OnLeaderboard(x, duMaurier1992) → Participated(x, duMaurier1992)) ::: All people on the leaderboard participated in the event.

Conclusion:
TieOnLeaderboard(Descampe, duMaurier1992) ::: Descampe is in the six-way tie on the leaderboard.
